purpose: Reproducible method-specific conversion of independently computed Fe nuclear densities; not a reference result

geometry_protocol.sequence: high-spin optimization followed by antiferromagnetic broken-symmetry optimization and frequency minimum validation

mossbauer_single_point_protocol.grid: DefGrid3, no special Fe integration-accuracy change
mossbauer_single_point_protocol.observable: electron density at each named Fe nucleus

calibration.validity: Method-specific calibration; do not transfer unchanged to a different Hamiltonian, basis, fitting basis, grid or density convention. These constants are inputs, not target Fe-site densities or isomer shifts.
